title: Power the Rack
lesson: Active gear is dark until PSU cords land on a PDU. Keep power and data on opposite mental paths — same habit as real racks (TIA-942 / BICSI).
brief: Facility power was pulled. Power ToR-SW-A and SERVER-01 from PDU-A, then bring the data path back: A-01↔Gi1/0/1 and Gi1/0/5↔eth0.
constraints: Use C13 power cords into PDU outlets
Data links stay down until devices are powered
